note: Corps of Engineers campground at the outlet of Big Sandy Lake, 13 miles north of McGregor, the only public campground and beach on the lake. The 1895 dam splits it into north and south halves with separate road entrances, joined only by a footpath across the dam; red and white pine and hardwoods, two lake boat ramps and a river ramp, docks, a fishing pier, a beach and a small lock-house museum. No firewood sold; bring certified firewood. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: 49 electric sites (50-amp; water at 4), 22-80 ft, 8 pull-throughs; $26 confirmed (doubles $52); season May 1-Oct 14; showers, laundry, dump. Waterfront: stored riverfront is on the wrong water - the south-peninsula sites sit ABOVE the dam on Big Sandy Lake, so riverfront -> lakefront (sites 09-14 on open grass ~20 m from the lake with a dock each). Pin ~460 m off in a residential area -> move.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> lakefront. The stored evidence ('Sandy River channel below the dam') misreads the water: on Esri topo and imagery the dam sits at ~46.7881,-93.3200 at the west end of the lake's outlet channel, and the south-peninsula sites lie east (upstream) of it, between that outlet arm and Big Sandy Lake itself. Sites 09-14 (46.78702,-93.31881 to 46.78705,-93.31963) face south onto the lake across ~15-25 m of open grass, each with a dock at the shore (z19, leaf-off: scattered deciduous trees, no continuous band). Sites 05-08 (46.78718,-93.31926 to 46.78715,-93.31892) face the outlet arm to the north across ~15-20 m with a few bare trees. Six-plus named sites within ~50 m over open ground on a lake -> lakefront. North-side sites 22-49 sit in woods by the marsh, not on open water. Suggested evidence: 'catalog sites 09-14 ~20 m from Big Sandy Lake over open grass, dock per site; above the dam (dam 46.7881,-93.3200, west of the peninsula)'.

Pin 46.78420,-93.32330 is in the residential area south-west of the campground, ~400 m from the nearest site (21) and ~460 m from the south loop. Move to 46.78710,-93.31930 (south-peninsula sites 01-14, by the South Entrance office/shower building).
Sites: max_rig_ft 100 (derived) -> 80 (site 34; the 92-ft figure is the North Group site). Some short south-side sites (09 at 22 ft, 08 at 24 ft, 10 at 25 ft); plenty of 30 ft+ sites fit a 23-ft rig.
